exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb + saseru".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb させる (Verb-saseru) matches "Verb + saseru".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb させる (Verb-saseru).
exercises.explanation: Expresses making or letting someone do an action; causative verb form.
